verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad first-party API covering accounting, budgets, team and cards, expenses, payments, transactions and webhooks, so much of the UI's core functionality is reachable programmatically. There is no claim of full UI parity, and the Travel API is view-only even though the UI supports in-app travel bookings and itinerary changes. Missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, write access for travel booking and changes, API coverage for UI features like AI-powered invoice automation and one-click accruals, independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage, and a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Team API: Manage users, locations, departments, and cards
Payments API: Manage vendors and send ACH, domestic wires, and checks
Expenses API: View and manage card expenses data, receipt match and receipt uploads
Budgets API: Manage budgets and budget programs
Accounting API: View and manage accounting data
Travel API: View trips made in Brex Travel
